comments.author: anon7000
comments.text: I think Wipr is also very trustworthy. It’s developed by an indie dev who’s responsive over email, and gives you a lot for free. And it has a $5/yr subscription (or one time payment) that unlocks system-wide ad blocking, not just in web views. I’ve found it to work exceptionally well after trying other free adblockers.

comments.author: armadyl
